summary: Detach and credential rotation retire the Core-local SMB/iSCSI secret with the repository. The Unused storage credentials panel is removed from the Controller Storage page; mid-flight leftovers are left alone.

guide.reason: Detach now removes Core credentials for that repository; the unused-credentials clean-up steps are removed.

api.reason: Successful storage-detach and credential-rotating storage-update retire the attached Core secret. List/retire credential endpoints remain for leftovers but are no longer used by the UI.

roadmap.reason: Storage credential lifecycle cleanup inside the existing storage repositories slice.

state.reason: Credential material stays Core-local; detach and rotation delete it on the host. Controller never stores the secret.
state.record: Core storage-credentials directory under the agent state dir; recovered only as redacted receipts in inventory when still present.

verification.method: go test for vmhost lifecycle detach-releases-credential; web typecheck if available; documentation gate. Browser integration scripts updated; no disposable lab walkthrough in this change.
